response.reason: The kernel performs symmetric per-row quantization (15 levels, step = max|w|/7), giving per-element quantization error std ≈ step/√12 ≈ 0.11 for Gaussian weights, which after dot-product error accumulation over 32 outputs and normalization by the reference norm (~7) yields a relative error around 0.06–0.08, comfortably within the 0.12 budget; with residual=0 there is no adversarial error-aligned component, and outputs are finite.
